title: Anti-CRISPR Protein AcrIIC5 Inhibits CRISPR-Cas9 by Occupying the Target DNA Binding Pocket.
authors: Hwang, Sungwon; Shah, Megha; Garcia, Bianca; Hashem, Noor; Davidson, Alan R; Moraes, Trevor F; Maxwell, Karen L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗CRISPR蛋白AcrIIC5通过占据Cas9的DNA结合口袋抑制其靶DNA结合，涉及蛋白-DNA互作界面与分子对接建模，虽非TF-DNA体系但方法可迁移至转录因子-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Anti-CRISPR proteins inhibit CRISPR-Cas immune systems through diverse mechanisms. Previously, the anti-CRISPR protein AcrIIC5(Smu) was shown to potently inhibit a type II-C Cas9 from Neisseria meningitidis (Nme1Cas9). In this work, we explore the mechanism of activity of the AcrIIC5 homologue from Neisseria chenwenguii (AcrIIC5(Nch)) and show that it prevents Cas9 binding to target DNA. We show that AcrIIC5(Nch) targets the PAM-interacting domain (PID) of Nme1Cas9 for inhibition, agreeing with previous findings for AcrIIC5(Smu), and newly establish that strong binding of the anti-CRISPR requires guide RNA be pre-loaded on Cas9. We determined the crystal structure of AcrIIC5(Nch) using X-ray crystallography and identified amino acid residues that are critical for its function. Using a protein docking algorithm we show that AcrIIC5(Nch) likely occupies the Cas9 DNA binding pocket, thereby inhibiting target DNA binding through a mechanism similar to that previously described for AcrIIA2 and AcrIIA4.
abstract_zh: 抗CRISPR蛋白通过多种机制抑制CRISPR-Cas免疫系统。此前，抗CRISPR蛋白AcrIIC5(Smu)被证明能有效抑制来自脑膜炎奈瑟菌（Neisseria meningitidis）的II-C型Cas9（Nme1Cas9）。在本研究中，我们探讨了来自陈文贵奈瑟菌（Neisseria chenwenguii）的AcrIIC5同源物（AcrIIC5(Nch)）的活性机制，并表明它能阻止Cas9与靶DNA结合。我们证明AcrIIC5(Nch)靶向Nme1Cas9的PAM相互作用结构域（PID）进行抑制，这与先前对AcrIIC5(Smu)的发现一致，并新确立了抗CRISPR蛋白的强效结合需要引导RNA预先加载到Cas9上。我们利用X射线晶体学确定了AcrIIC5(Nch)的晶体结构，并识别了对其功能至关重要的氨基酸残基。通过蛋白质对接算法，我们表明AcrIIC5(Nch)可能占据Cas9的DNA结合口袋，从而通过类似于先前描述的AcrIIA2和AcrIIA4的机制抑制靶DNA结合。
